title: taraxacum officinale subsp. gymnanthum
intro: Taraxacum officinale subsp. gymnanthum, commonly known as Welsh dandelion, is a plant species that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, skin conditions, and liver diseases, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Welsh dandelion include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and diuretic properties, which help to reduce swelling, prevent infections, and promote urine production. The bioactive constituents of Welsh dandelion include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
